chapterInfo.content:
4
Kaneadua ho anisoadehunu
1Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no sane bae, ɔbɛnyanee me sɛ onipa a wɔnyane no firi ne nna mu, 2#Yer 1.11, 13; Amos 8.2; Eks 25.31-40 na ɔbisaa me sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi? Na mese: Mehunu kaneadua a ne nyinaa yɛ sika, na ne ngo toa tae atifi, na ne nkanea nson wowɔ soɔ, adorobɛn nson nson wɔ hɔ ma atifi nkanea no. 3Na ngo nnua mmienu sisi hɔ, baako si ngo toa no nifa, na baako si ne benkum soɔ. 4Na mebua mesee ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne yeinom, me wura? 5Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no gyee so bisaa me sɛ: Wonnim adekodeɛ a yeinom yɛ? Na mese: Dabi, me wura. 6Na ɔbua see me sɛ: Yei ne AWURADE asɛm a ɛbaa Serubabel nkyɛn no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ wo tumi so, na ɛnyɛ w’ahoɔden soɔ, na mmom me honhom so, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 7#Dwom 122.6 Hwan ne wo, bepɔ kɛseɛ? Wobɛdane asaseta wɔ Serubabel anim! Na ɔde atifi boɔ bɛfiri adi aba, na wɔabɔ so ose sɛ: Adom, adom mmra so.
8Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 9#Esra 3.8; 6.14-16; Sak 2.9, 11 Serubabel nsa na ato efie yi fapem, na ne nsa ara na ɛbɛwie, na woahunu sɛ asafo AWURADE na asoma me mo nkyɛn. 10#Hag 2.3; Sak 3.9 Na sɛ wɔbuu adwuma mfitiaseɛ ketewa yi animtia mpo a, wɔn ani bɛgye berɛ a wɔbɛhu kyirebennyɛ no wɔ Serubabel nsam. Na kaneadua nson a wo hunuiɛ no ne AWURADE ani a ɛdi akɔneaba asase nyinaa soɔ no.
11Na mebisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne kaneadua no nifa ne ne benkum ngo nnua mmienu yi? 12Na mebuaa ne mprenu so see no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne ngo nnua no mman mmienu a ɛwowɔ sika ano mmienu a ɛhwie sika no ma no firi mu guo no ho yi? 13Na ɔbisaa me sɛ: Wonnim deɛ yeinom yɛ? Na mese: Dabi, me wura. 14#Adi 11.4 Na ɔse: Yeinom ne nnipa mmienu a wɔasra wɔn ngo a wɔgyinagyina asase nyinaa wura no nkyɛn.

Na sɛ wɔbuu adwuma mfitiaseɛ ketewa yi animtia mpo a, wɔn ani bɛgye berɛ a wɔbɛhu kyirebennyɛ no wɔ Serubabel nsam. Na kaneadua nson a wo hunuiɛ no ne AWURADE ani a ɛdi akɔneaba asase nyinaa soɔ no.

Na ɔse: Yeinom ne nnipa mmienu a wɔasra wɔn ngo a wɔgyinagyina asase nyinaa wura no nkyɛn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
